playwright.description: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP for browser automation (navigate, click, fill forms, screenshots, network/console inspection). Lets Claude Code drive a real browser to test JARVIS's dashboard (dashboard/static/app.html, login.html) and any web-facing features directly.

elevenlabs.description: Official ElevenLabs MCP for text-to-speech, voice cloning, audio processing, and transcription. JARVIS's core/tts.py already supports ElevenLabs as a TTS engine (config key elevenlabs_api_key) — this lets Claude Code test/design voices directly.

chrome-devtools.description: Official Chrome DevTools MCP — real Chrome DevTools Protocol access (network/console inspection, performance/Lighthouse traces, DOM interaction, screenshots). Gives JARVIS itself a browser-control tool at runtime, not just Claude Code.

blender.description: BlenderMCP — live control of a running Blender scene (scene/object info, viewport screenshots, arbitrary Python execution, Poly Haven/Sketchfab/Poly Pizza asset import, Hyper3D/Hunyuan3D text-to-3D generation). Requires Blender open with its BlenderMCP addon (View3D > Sidebar > BlenderMCP) — the addon auto-starts its socket server on port 9876 when Blender loads. Complements plugins/blender_controller.py, which drives headless Blender for one-shot renders/exports without needing Blender open.
